description: Paket 7 B2: optional word diff fixtures shared by npm test (tests/unit/intraline.test.ts) and cargo test (src-tauri/src/diff/intraline_tests.rs). `tokens`: tokenizer results. `cases`: the complete analysis of the line diff of old/new (default limits unless `limits` overrides some). `generated`: random cases (with random small limits) from the same xorshift32 generator in both suites, compared through a digest. Expected values of `cases` were reviewed by hand.

notation.pairs: oldLine/newLine of the paired deleted/inserted lines, similarity [common, total] (Dice = 2*common/total), segments [op, text] with "=" equal, "-" delete (old side), "+" insert (new side); or `skipped` instead of segments
notation.skipped: lines without word diff: reason lineTooLong | hunkTooLarge | budgetExceeded, old and new line numbers
notation.work: work units of the analysis (tokens + similarity cells + token alignments)
notation.similarity: similarity tokens: significant tokens (words, numbers, CJK, emoji, symbols); a line without them uses its punctuation tokens
notation.invalidAnalyses: complete analyses for the runtime validator (JS only, intralineError): valid ones and forged ones that must be rejected
